string.text: Graphics are set for this device. Quality shows the best picture it can keep steady: 40 frames per second on a 120 Hz iPad display (30 on a 60 Hz one), 60 on a Mac. Performance lowers the render resolution for a locked 60 frames per second, and runs at 120 on a Mac display that has it.

Quality: the best picture at a steady 40 frames per second (30 on a 60 Hz display, 60 on a Mac). Performance: lower render resolution for a locked 60 frames per second, or 120 on a 120 Hz Mac display.
Limits the frame rate to a rate the display shows evenly. Auto uses the mode's rate: Quality 40 on a 120 Hz iPad display, 30 on a 60 Hz one, 60 on a Mac; Performance 60 (120 on a 120 Hz Mac display).
Size of the text in menus and on the HUD. The text follows the screen's height by itself; this makes it larger or smaller still. Applies when the video restarts.
